messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — P1: dedicated pool aurora-3 (region-us-west2) high-error spike + log-level override detected for tenant np-873. Auto-aggregation shows debug logs started at 2026-03-15T02:00Z. Pager: oncall-alex

oncall-alex: grabbing this. show me the signal and whether customer-facing requests are failing or it's internal noise :eyes:

sre-priya: looking. Errors correspond to a temporary log-level env override that was applied during a hotfix deploy to aurora-3; value set was LOG_LEVEL=debug for the tenant routing plugin. Not seeing 5xxs at the load balancer layer, but logs include raw audit payloads (search hits with PII fields like ssn/email) — bucketed under /var/logs/aurora/np-873/audit.log.debug

eng-matt: confirmed, I can repro on a staging replica with the same config. The override came from a runbook snippet we used: `kubectl set env deploy/aura-plugin LOG_LEVEL=debug --namespace np-873` — someone pasted it to speed up tracing. :/

se-carlos: customer NorthPoint has strict retention + redaction requirements per contract. We need an immediate containment plan before any internal postmortem copies get exported. Also notify legal ASAP.

oncall-alex: immediate actions: 1) disable debug override 2) revoke temporary debug keys 3) lock access to logs 4) snapshot logs to a locked bucket for legal review. Who can run the fix now?

eng-matt: I'm on it. Running this to turn off debug: ```
# disable tenant-level debug
kubectl set env deploy/aura-plugin LOG_LEVEL=info --namespace np-873
kubectl rollout restart deploy/aura-plugin -n np-873
```

infra-ops-bot: Command executed by eng-matt at 2026-03-15T02:04Z: rollout started for aura-plugin (np-873).

eng-matt: done — rollout completed, log verbosity back to INFO on the cluster node set. I'll tail the log stream to verify no new debug lines.

sre-priya: verification: debug lines stop after 02:05Z. However, debug file with sensitive payloads already exists on node mounts and in the fluentd staging buffer. We must prevent any downstream exports/retention jobs.

oncall-alex: block any scheduled ETL/export jobs for np-873 and pause retention cleanup. Can infra-ops-bot toggle export pipelines?

infra-ops-bot: export pipeline np-873-export paused by infra-ops-bot at 2026-03-15T02:07Z per request from oncall-alex.

eng-matt: snapshot step below — creating a forensics snapshot and copying to a locked S3 bucket with limited ACL + KMS CMK:r-internal-forensics. ```
# snapshot logs
sudo tar -czf /tmp/np-873-audit-debug-20260315.tgz /var/log/aurora/np-873/audit.log.debug
aws s3 cp /tmp/np-873-audit-debug-20260315.tgz s3://r-forensics-locked/np-873/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1111:key/r-internal-forensics
```

sre-priya: pause: do not copy raw snapshot to general forensics bucket. Legal requested a write-once isolated bucket for review. eng-matt, instead put the file into a quarantined bucket `s3://np-873-legal-hold` with ACL restricted to legal + compliance + oncall.

eng-matt: ack, changing target. Running copy to `s3://np-873-legal-hold/forensic/` with bucket policy locked.

infra-ops-bot: S3 put-object recorded at 2026-03-15T02:10Z into s3://np-873-legal-hold/forensic/ by eng-matt. Object ACL: private. KMS: r-legal-hold.

legal-jane: I'm in. Per contract we need a formal chain-of-custody for the artifact. Do NOT redact or modify snapshot until Legal & Compliance ingest it. We'll request a narrow list of fields to be extracted if needed. Also tagging this as a potential exceptions-to-redaction case; we need to determine whether the PII in logs triggers mandatory notification.

compliance-mark: adding hold: retention-hold set on tenant np-873 logs and related indexes to prevent deletion/overwrite. Also creating Ticket INC-20260315-091 for record.

oncall-alex: access control: who currently has ssh or kibana access to np-873 logs? We need a short list.

eng-matt: before I revoke: me, priya, se-carlos, obs-bot service account, and the temporary key `debug-temp-key-march15`.

oncall-alex: revoke the temporary key and rotate any admin tokens that were used. eng-matt or infra-ops-bot can run rotation.

infra-ops-bot: temp key debug-temp-key-march15 revoked by infra-ops-bot at 2026-03-15T02:14Z. Admin token rotation initiated for session tokens tied to the debug runbook.

se-carlos: notify customer liaison (cc: account-ops) and advise them we're containing and engaging legal for compliance review. Draft note ready for account-ops to send? Short message only.

oncall-alex: draft: "We identified debug-level logs containing audit payloads during internal troubleshooting on your dedicated pool. We've contained the issue, placed affected files on legal hold, and engaged our legal/compliance teams. We will follow up within 4 hours with details." Anyone object?

se-carlos: send that. We should avoid listing PII types in customer-facing message. keep it high level.

legal-jane: agreed. I'll prepare escalation matrix for whether we need to notify regulators or customers per the data protection clause. Please do not run any redaction scripts yet — legal wants to inspect raw snapshot first.

sre-priya: quick risk note: fluentd staging buffer might have forwarded partial records to our long-term ES indices between 02:00-02:05Z. I'm running a narrow query to list document IDs and count hits. If there are copies in ES we need to put the index into read-only mode and snapshot it. ```
# ES query (internal)
GET /logs-*/_search?q=tenant_id:np-873 AND timestamp:[2026-03-15T02:00:00 TO 2026-03-15T02:05:59]&size=0
```

sre-priya: result: 72 hits across indices logs-audit-2026.03.15 and logs-router-2026.03.15. Initiating index freeze + snapshot to `s3://np-873-legal-hold/es-snapshots/` now.

infra-ops-bot: es-index logs-audit-2026.03.15 set to read-only by infra-ops-bot at 2026-03-15T02:18Z. Snapshot started.

legal-jane: once ES snapshot is in the legal-hold bucket, we'll schedule a secure review call with engineering and a cust rep (optional) to determine disclosure requirements. Also please produce an access log showing who pulled/debugged the runbook.

eng-matt: producing runbook audit: timestamps and approvers: `matt` applied change at 02:03Z; source was pasted from runbook-id: runbook/debugging/quickfix-2026.md. I'll attach the audit to the ticket.

oncall-alex: summary of actions (for handoff): 1) debug override removed (02:04Z) 2) exports paused (02:07Z) 3) temp key revoked (02:14Z) 4) forensic snapshots stored in s3://np-873-legal-hold (02:10Z & 02:20Z) 5) ES indices frozen & snapshot (02:18Z) 6) legal & compliance engaged (02:12Z) 7) customer liaison notified (02:15Z). Handoff to daytime oncall in 20m: @sre-priya will take incident lead for next shift; ensure legal provides next steps re: redaction vs notification.

sre-priya: acknowledged for handoff. I'll monitor retention enforcement and access logs. Setting a follow-up 1:1 with legal-jane in 30 minutes.

legal-jane: I'll aim to have an initial determination on notification requirements within the 4-hour SLA. If we decide notification is required, account-ops will coordinate messaging. For now: legal hold remains and no redaction or deletion.

oncall-alex: thanks team. Patch note: we should update the debugging runbook to require an explicit flag and two-person approval before applying tenant-level debug overrides on dedicated pools. I'll create a follow-up RFC. :white_check_mark:

eng-matt: will stub the RFC and add canary/test step to avoid accidental debug toggles in prod.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-091 created and linked to thread 1945000000. Priority: P1.

infra-ops-bot: Handoff reminder scheduled for 2026-03-15T02:30Z to @sre-priya.

oncall-alex: closing pager for now. All mitigations applied; legal hold active. If anything new shows up, re-page P1. :thumbsup:

sre-priya: note for oncall: monitor ES ingest and any outbound S3 ACL changes. I'll keep the thread updated.

legal-jane: attaching compliance checklist to INC-20260315-091 and adding required approvers.

eng-matt: FYI — opened PR to change runbook quickfix to require `--confirm-two-person` flag and log approver. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/482

se-carlos: account-ops notified and preparing customer message.

oncall-alex: thread will serve as the single source of truth for this incident. Handoff complete.

(reacts: many :thumbsup: and :eyes:)
